drafted_from: tool row in tools/connected-drives/tool-rows.json, read-data/drives.mjs and test/drives.test.mjs
start_here: Say to your AI: "Which programs are stopping my SAMPLE DRIVE from ejecting?" It runs tool:name-what-holds-a-drive with mount /Volumes/SAMPLE DRIVE and names each program that has a file open there.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads the drives this computer shows and changes nothing.
instructions: 1. Run tool:list-connected-drives and copy the mount of the drive that will not eject.
2. Say "Which programs are using /Volumes/SAMPLE DRIVE?"; the AI calls tools:run for tool:name-what-holds-a-drive with that mount.
3. Read processes (pid and name). Close each named program, then eject the drive; an empty list means nothing has a file open there.
4. A mount that is not connected is refused with "not connected".
